heading: 續三綱行實圖 · 孝 孝子 효자 · Filial Children · 續孝 34 金淑孫 … 續孝 35 鄭継周

items.text: Son, after your parents die, live at their grave and mourn for three years.
items.quote: 侍墓를 三年곰 ᄒᆞ고 — kept the grave for three years

items.text: Son, build a shrine beside your parents' grave and offer morning and evening food offerings as if they were alive, without slack even into old age.
items.quote: 무덤 겨틔 祠堂 ᄆᆡᇰᄀᆞ라 두고 아ᄎᆞᆷ나죄 飯祭호ᄆᆞᆯ 산적ᄀᆞ티ᄒᆞ야 — built a shrine by the grave and morning and evening offered rice offerings as if alive
items.conflict: Conflicts with the prohibition of offering food to the dead (Deut 26:14).

items.text: Son, when you go out, tell your mother; when you return, come to see her; and diligently look after her comfort in heat and cold.
items.quote: 나갈 제 告ᄒᆞ고 도라와 뵈며 닐 제 잘 제와 더옴과 치옴 ᄉᆞᆲ펴보ᄆᆞᆯ 죠고마도 게을이 아니터니 — when going out he told her, when returning he visited her, and looked after her warmth and cold without slack

items.text: Son, when your mother dies, live at her grave and mourn for three years.
items.quote: 어미 죽거늘 三年 侍墓ᄒᆞ고 — when mother died, he kept the grave for three years

items.text: Son, after completing mourning for your mother, also wear mourning for your father for three years as he was not fully mourned before.
items.quote: 脱喪ᄒᆞ고 ᄯᅩ 아비 위ᄒᆞ야 믈려 三年을 니브니라 — after taking off mourning, he again for his father wore mourning for three years

items.text: Son, offer seasonal and anniversary rites for your parents with utmost sincerity until old age.
items.quote: 時享忌日祭ᄒᆞᆯ 제 의식울오 孝誠이 늙도록 더욱 지극더라 — in seasonal and anniversary rites, his filial sincerity became more extreme into old age
items.conflict: Conflicts with the prohibition of worship of the dead.

heading: 續三綱行實圖 · 忠 忠臣 충신 · Loyal Subjects · 續忠 1 孫炎 … 續忠 5 金同

items.text: Protect your elder brother's life and name; refuse to save yourself by denying him, and bear the blame with him.
items.quote: 내 버스면 하ᇰ거시 죄를 니브리니 하ᇰ것 죄니 괴고 내 살사로ᄆᆞᆯ ᄎᆞ마 몯ᄒᆞ로라 — If I am released, my brother will bear the blame; I cannot bear to live while my brother suffers.

items.text: Do not abandon your mother even when facing death; grieve that you must leave her, and make provision for her care.
items.quote: 어미 ᄇᆞ리고 주그미 진실로 부ᄒᆈ나 내 하ᇰ거시 이시면 어미를 어엿비 너길 거시니 슬혀 말라 — To die leaving my mother is truly unfilial; but if my brother is alive, he will care for you, so do not grieve.

items.text: Take up the care of your mother when your younger brother cannot provide for her.
items.quote: 내 하ᇰ거시 이시면 어미를 어엿비 너길 거시니 — If my brother is alive, he will care for you.

items.text: Ensure that your aging mother is fed and cared for, even when you face your own death.
items.quote: 내 하ᇰ거시 어러이 머리 귀햐ᇰ가거늘 뉘 머기ᄂᆞᆫ 고ᄒᆞ고 — My brother is going far away; who will feed her?

heading: 續三綱行實圖 · 烈 烈女 열녀 · Faithful Women · 續烈 25 玉今 … 續烈 26 玉今

items.text: Remain chaste for your deceased husband; do not give yourself to any other man.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續烈 25 玉今
items.quote: 제 ᄆᆞᄉᆞᆯ 사ᄅᆞ미 길헤 맛보아 어루려 커늘 거스러 좃디 아니더니 — a man tried to take her; she resisted and did not follow.
items.conflict: 1 Cor 7:39 and Rom 7:2-3 free a widow to remarry; the Bible does not require perpetual chastity to a dead spouse.

items.text: After your husband dies, continue to live with and serve his parents.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續烈 25 玉今
items.quote: 남지니 죽거ᄂᆞᆯ 싀어버이 조차 사더니 — when her husband died, she lived with her in-laws.

items.text: Offer morning and evening sacrifices to your deceased husband during the mourning period.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續烈 26 玉今
items.quote: 아ᄎᆞᆷ나죄 ᄒᆞᄅᆞ보로매 親히 祭ᄒᆞ더니 — morning and evening every day she personally offered sacrifice.
items.conflict: Deut 18:10-12 forbids consulting or sacrificing to the dead; Heb 9:27 says after death comes judgment, no communication.

items.text: Do not remarry, even if your parents arrange it; remain faithful to your dead husband.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續烈 26 玉今
items.quote: 다ᄅᆞᆫ 남진 얼요려 中媒ᄒᆞ야 基約을 一정ᄒᆞ야ᄂᆞᆯ — arranged another husband through a matchmaker and fixed a contract.
items.conflict: 1 Cor 7:39 permits a widow to marry whomever she wishes in the Lord; parental authority does not override this freedom.

heading: 續三綱行實圖 · 孝 孝子 효자 · Filial Children · 續孝 11 別侍衛 黄信之 … 續孝 24 同知中枢河友明

items.text: When a parent is ill, stay and nurse them yourself; even taste their excrement to know whether the disease is bitter or sweet, and do not flee for fear of contagion.
items.quote: 어ᄆᆡ 大便을 맛보니 ᄡᅳ더니 果然 病이 됴ᄒᆞ니라 — He tasted his mother's excrement; it was bitter, and the disease improved.

items.text: If your parent is seized by a wild beast or trapped in fire, rush in and rescue them at the risk of your own life.
items.quote: 브레 ᄃᆞ라 드러 아비 어버 내다가 — He rushed into the fire and carried out his father.

items.text: Pray for your parent's recovery, even offering your own life in exchange.
items.quote: 하ᄂᆞᆯ 브르고 목숨을 빈대 사ᄒᆞᆺ날재 다시 살아 — He called on Heaven and offered his life; after three days she revived.

items.text: Keep three years' mourning at the grave, not going home, and abstain from rich food.
items.quote: 三年侍墓ᄒᆞ고 소곰이며 ᄂᆞᄆᆞᆯᄋᆞᆯ 먹디 아니터라 — He kept three years' grave-mourning and ate no salt or vegetables.
items.conflict: Man-made tradition; not commanded in Scripture (Mark 7:7-8).

items.text: Offer morning and evening meals and seasonal sacrifices at the shrine or spirit tablet all your life.
items.quote: 아ᄎᆞᆷ나죄 祭ᄒᆞ더라 — He sacrificed morning and evening.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites are idolatry; worship God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: Build a shrine or portrait hall for your deceased parents, and on every festival offer sacrifices there before anything else.
items.quote: 影堂 짓고 믈읫 時節 거시어든 의식 몬져 祭ᄒᆞ고 — He built a portrait hall, and at every season he first offered sacrifice with proper food.
items.conflict: Making and venerating images of the dead violates the second commandment (Exodus 20:4-5).

items.text: Cut your finger and mix the blood and flesh into medicine for your parent's illness.
items.quote: 손ᄭᅡ락을 버혀 薬애 섯거 머기니 病이 됴ᄒᆞ니라 — He cut his finger and mixed it into the medicine; the illness improved.
items.conflict: Self-mutilation; your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit (1 Corinthians 6:19-20).

items.text: After your father's death, visit your stepmother daily, see that she has food, and care for her.
items.quote: 繼母ᄅᆞᆯ 뵈오 머글 것ᄃᆞᆯ ᄉᆞᆲ펴보고 — He visited his stepmother and examined what she had to eat.

items.text: When family property is divided, take the worse share for yourself and give the better to your brothers.
items.quote: 다 사오나온 받과 늘근 죠ᇰ을 제 모긔 내고 그 나ᄆᆞ니란 兄弟를 준대 — He took the worst field and the old slave for himself, and gave the rest to his brothers.

items.text: If your father's grave is elsewhere, rebury him beside your mother, and then keep mourning again.
items.quote: 아비를 어믜 墳墓 ㅅ겨틔 遷獎ᄒᆞ고 ᄯᅩ 三年 侍墓ᄒᆞ니 — He moved his father's grave beside his mother's and again kept three years' grave-mourning.
items.conflict: Reburial and prolonged mourning are superstitious; not commanded.

items.text: Serve and support your parents with utmost filial piety all their days, even in poverty.
items.quote: 어미 孝養호ᄆᆞᆯ 지그기 ᄒᆞ더니 — He served his mother with utmost filial devotion.

heading: 續三綱行實圖 · 孝 孝子 효자 · Filial Children · 續孝 25 慶延 … 續孝 33 正兵 羅有文

items.text: When your parent is ill and longs for something, try hard to obtain it, even in bitter winter.
items.quote: 아비 病ᄒᆞ야셔 ᄀᆞ자ᇰ 치위예 生鮮을 먹고져커늘 延이 그믈 가지고 므레 드러 鯉魚 둘흘 어더 머긴대

items.text: Set aside good food for your parents and personally prepare their meals.
items.quote: 의식 푸머다가 이받더니

items.text: When your parents are ill, tend them constantly, not undressing, and even taste their excrement to know their condition.
items.quote: 옷닙고 ᄯᅴ 밧디 아니ᄒᆞ야 새도록 자디 아니코 大便을 맛보며

items.text: Keep a grave-side hut for the full mourning period and abstain from rich foods.
items.quote: 侍墓ᄅᆞᆯ 여슷ᄒᆡ를 호ᄃᆡ

items.text: Offer morning and evening sacrifices to your deceased parents at the shrine or grave.
items.quote: 祠堂애 아ᄎᆞᆷ나죄 飯祭ᄒᆞ며
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with exclusive worship of God.

items.text: On festive days, invite elders to offer birthday toasts to your parents.
items.quote: 의식 ᄆᆞᅀᆞᆯ 얼운을 쳥하야다가 어버ᅀᅴ게 献寿ᄒᆞ더라

items.text: When your parent is old or blind, stay by their side, help them up and down, and feed them.
items.quote: 아비 눈 몯보거늘 나며 들며 제 ᄆᆡ야ᇰ ᄢᅵ들며 飲食을 의식 親히 이받더니

items.text: When your parent is gravely ill, do not spare your own body; cut your finger and mix the blood with medicine.
items.quote: 제 손ᄭᅡ락을 버혀 야개 섯거 머긴대
items.conflict: Self-mutilation not required; body is temple of the Holy Spirit.

items.text: Refuse gifts that would stain your deceased husband's good name.
items.quote: 엇디 내 남지ᄂᆡ 清白을 더러이로 ᄒᆞ고 다받디 아니ᄒᆞ니라

items.text: Perform the three-year ancestral rites for your mother-in-law morning and evening without fail.
items.quote: 어믜 三年祭을 내 사라 이실적 ᄀᆞ티ᄒᆞ야 아ᄎᆞᆷ나죄 게을이 말오
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with exclusive worship of God.

items.text: Bury your husband as he instructed and personally offer sacrifices at his grave.
items.quote: 나ᄅᆞᆯ 어믜 무덤겨틔 무드라
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with exclusive worship of God.

items.text: When your father is killed unjustly, mourn him to the point of refusing food.
items.quote: 아비 罪업시 주근 주를 셜이 너겨 가ᄉᆞᆷ 두드려 울오 飲食을 아니 먹고 주그니
items.conflict: Life is sacred; excessive grief leading to death is not required.

heading: 續三綱行實圖 · 孝 孝子 효자 · Filial Children · 續孝 1 王中 … 續孝 10 梁郁

items.text: Keep three years' grave-watch by your parent's tomb: wear mourning clothes, eat only gruel each day, weep morning and evening, offer sacrifice, and do not wash your hair or change your clothes.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續孝 1 王中 … 續孝 10 梁郁
items.quote: 三年侍墓ᄒᆞ야 딛옷 닙고 나날 粥 머그며 아ᄎᆞᆷ나죄 울오 祭ᄒᆞ며 — kept three years' grave-watch, wore mourning clothes, daily ate only gruel, wept morning and evening, offered sacrifice
items.conflict: Offerings to the dead are forbidden (Deut. 18:10-12).

items.text: At the ancestral shrine, bow morning and evening, offer the new-month and full-moon sacrifices, present the first fruits, and report all household matters to the ancestors before acting.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續孝 1 王中 … 續孝 10 梁郁
items.quote: 祠堂애 아ᄎᆞᆷ나죄 의식 절ᄒᆞ고 朔望祭와 薦新ᅟᅵᆯ 궐티 아니ᄒᆞ며 — at the ancestral shrine morning and evening he bowed, the new and full moon sacrifices and the offering of first fruits he never omitted
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is idolatry (Exod. 20:3-5); prayer and sacrifice belong to God alone.

items.text: Tend your sick parent without revulsion: taste his stool to learn if he is mending, suck the boils from his body, and take his lice upon yourself.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續孝 1 王中 … 續孝 10 梁郁
items.quote: 어미 위ᄒᆞ야 브ᅀᅳ럼 ᄲᆞᆯ며 아비 위ᄒᆞ야 大便을 맛보며 — for his mother he sucked the boils, for his father he tasted the stool

items.text: When your parent is ill, pray earnestly to Heaven, even offering to take the illness upon yourself in his place.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續孝 1 王中 … 續孝 10 梁郁
items.quote: 하ᄂᆞᆯᄭᅴ 비러 제 모모로 代身 ᄒᆞ야지라 — he prayed to Heaven, asking to substitute himself for her

items.text: Provide the particular food your sick parent craves; if you cannot find it, grieve and keep seeking until you obtain it.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續孝 1 王中 … 續孝 10 梁郁
items.quote: 어미 ᄯᅩ 놀ᄋᆡ 고기 먹고쟈 커늘 炳이 이러뎌러 가 얻다가 몯ᄒᆞ야 — his mother craved roe deer meat; Bing went everywhere to get it but could not

items.text: Do not leave your aged parent's side; remain with him always.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續孝 1 王中 … 續孝 10 梁郁
items.quote: 아븨 겨틔 ᄠᅥ나디 아니ᄒᆞ더니 — he did not leave his father's side

items.text: If your parent is attacked by a wild beast, do not flee; fight the beast to rescue him, even at the risk of your own life.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續孝 1 王中 … 續孝 10 梁郁
items.quote: 왼소노로 아ᄇᆡ 발 잡고 올ᄒᆞᆫ소노로 나ᄃᆞᆯ 휫두루며 버믈 저티고 — with his left hand he grabbed his father's leg and with his right hand he swung the sickle and struck the tiger

items.text: Avenge your father's murder; do not rest until his killer is killed.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續孝 1 王中 … 續孝 10 梁郁
items.quote: 아븨 怨讐를 갑디 몯ᄒᆞ야 셜워 — she grieved, unable to avenge her father's murder
items.conflict: Vengeance belongs to God, not man (Rom. 12:19; Deut. 32:35).

items.text: Serve your father's concubines as you served him while he lived, and mourn their deaths with a full year of mourning.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續孝 1 王中 … 續孝 10 梁郁
items.quote: 아ᄇᆡ 妾 둘히 잇거늘 셤교ᄃᆡ 아비 사라 이실 적ᄀᆞ티 ᄒᆞ더니 — his father had two concubines; he served them as he had when his father was alive

items.text: Keep your parent's grave in good repair: carry earth and stones to build it up and maintain it.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續孝 1 王中 … 續孝 10 梁郁
items.quote: ᄒᆞᆰ과 돌ᄒᆞᆯ 지여 무덤 ᄆᆡᇰᄀᆞ더니 — he carried earth and stones and built up the grave

heading: 續三綱行實圖 · 烈 烈女 열녀 · Faithful Women · 續烈 12 徐氏 … 續烈 24 召史

items.text: Do not take another husband; remain faithful to your deceased husband, even making a vow.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續烈 14 仇氏
items.quote: 머리털 버히고 盟誓호되 다시 남진 아니호리라 ᄒᆞ고 — cut her hair and swore she would not take another husband
items.conflict: A widow is free to remarry, only in the Lord; forbidding marriage is a doctrine of demons.

items.text: Mourn your husband for three years, wearing old clothes and eating only coarse food.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續烈 19 権氏
items.quote: 三年을 아ᄎᆞᆷ나죄 무덤 겨틔 ᄠᅥ나디 아니ᄒᆞ더니 — for three years she did not leave the grave, morning or evening

items.text: Offer morning and evening sacrifices to your husband, and when going out or coming in, report to his spirit.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續烈 14 仇氏
items.quote: 아ᄎᆞᆷ나죄 祭ᄒᆞ며 나가며 들어올 제 반ᄃᆞ시 告ᄒᆞ며 — morning and evening offered sacrifice, and when going out and coming in always reported
items.conflict: Sacrifice to the dead is worship of the creature; the dead cannot hear or receive offerings.

items.text: Keep the seasonal sacrifices to your husband according to the prescribed rites.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續烈 14 仇氏
items.quote: 시절거슬 의식 祭ᄒᆞ고 — offered the seasonal sacrifices according to the rites
items.conflict: God alone is to be worshiped; offerings to the dead are forbidden.

items.text: Rather than be taken by another man, choose death; hang yourself or starve.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續烈 13 石今
items.quote: 목ᄆᆡ야 주그니라 — hanged herself and died
items.conflict: You shall not murder; your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit; do not take your own life.

items.text: Serve your husband's mother with all filial piety, even rescuing her from a burning house.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續烈 22 寓氏
items.quote: 싀어미ᄅᆞᆯ 셤기ᄃᆡ ᄀᆞ쟈ᇰ 효도ᄒᆞ더니 지비 블븓거늘 싀어미 늙고 病들어 니러 나디 몯ᄒᆞ더니 寓氏 브레 드러가 어버내서니라 — served her mother-in-law with utmost filial piety; when the house caught fire and the mother-in-law was too old and sick to rise, she went into the fire and carried her out

items.text: Bury your husband's mother and offer the proper funeral and mourning sacrifices.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續烈 22 寓氏
items.quote: 送葬과 祭奠을 礼다ᄋᆡ ᄒᆞ니라 — performed the funeral and sacrifices according to the rites
items.conflict: Sacrifices to the dead are idolatry.

items.text: Protect your child, even risking your own life against wild beasts.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 續烈 19 権氏
items.quote: 버미와 아기를 더위여 가거ᄂᆞᆯ 権氏 왼녁 소노로 아기 잡고 올ᄒᆞᆫ 소노로 버믈 믈리ᄫᅡᄃᆞ며 — when a tiger seized the child, she held the child with her left hand and pushed the tiger away with her right

heading: 續三綱行實圖 · 烈 烈女 열녀 · Faithful Women · 續烈 1 白氏 … 續烈 11 崔氏

items.text: Serve your husband's parents as your own, even when your husband has abandoned or died, and provide for them in need.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 烈女 續烈 1
items.quote: 싀어미을 이받고 나가디 아니ᄒᆞ야 — She served her mother-in-law and did not leave.

items.text: Care for your husband diligently when he is sick.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 烈女 續烈 4
items.quote: 許梅 侍病호ᄆᆞᆯ 지그기 ᄒᆞ더니 — 許梅 attended to his illness diligently.

items.text: Remain faithful to your deceased husband; do not marry another man.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 烈女 續烈 11
items.quote: 죽도록 남진 아니ᄒᆞ니라 — She did not take another husband until death.
items.conflict: 1 Cor 7:39: A wife is bound as long as her husband lives; but if her husband is dead, she is free to be married to whom she will, only in the Lord.

items.text: Offer sacrifices and memorials to your deceased parents-in-law, honoring them as in life.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 烈女 續烈 1
items.quote: 싀어믜 야ᇰᄌᆞᄅᆞᆯ 그려 두고 죽도록 祭ᄒᆞ니라 — She drew a picture of her mother-in-law and offered sacrifices until death.

items.text: Remain faithful to your husband when he is missing, and do not remarry until his death is certain.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 烈女 續烈 9
items.quote: 주근도ᇰ 산도ᇰ 몰라 ... 좃디 아니ᄒᆞ더니 — Not knowing whether he was dead or alive, she did not follow another.

items.text: Prioritize caring for your mother-in-law above your own parents' wishes, especially when she has no other support.
items.citation: Sok Samgang Haengsildo, 烈女 續烈 10
items.quote: 싀어미 ᄃᆞ려와 살며 親히 飲食ᄒᆞ야 주더니 — She brought her mother-in-law to live with her and personally prepared food.
